notes: יָבֹאוּ בָ → invaded retained as a contiguous verb-plus-preposition fusion: invaded carries the entering as well as the coming, and the same chapter fuses וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחַר → followed on the same terms (rule 30). Leaving the בְּ unrepresented under rule 40 (as for blew the trumpet) is the competing reading and remains defensible.
בָּא שָׁנָה → at the coming in of the year: supplied at, the and of belong to the bare participle and noun they introduce (rules 15, 33).
